name: 全链路场景：F88 任务大厅 → 个人任务中心 → 审核详情 → 操作 → 通过/驳回 → 进度/通过率一致性
description: 从任务大厅切入，遍历四种构造来源（策略平台-F88/策略平台-测试/手动创建/模版库），进入个人任务中心选取有数据的审核任务，进入审核详情页验证工具栏按钮，执行通过或驳回，最后回个人任务中心校验进度与通过率是否同步更新。

steps.description: 验证策略平台-F88 tab存在
验证策略平台相关tab存在
切换到策略平台-测试来源tab
等待个人任务中心加载

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tr[data-row-key]')); const row = rows[0]; if (!row) return null; const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td'); const progressCell = Array.from(cells).find(c => /进行|完成|待开始|\d\/\d/.test(c.innerText)); const passRateCell = Array.from(cells).find(c => /%|通过/.test(c.innerText)); const opCell = Array.from(cells).find(c => c.innerText.includes('查看详情')); const detailLink = opCell ? opCell.querySelector('a') : null; const href = detailLink?.getAttribute('href') || ''; const taskIdMatch = href.match(/[?&]taskId=([^&]+)/); return { taskName: cells[0]?.innerText?.trim(), progressText: progressCell?.innerText?.trim(), passRateText: passRateCell?.innerText?.trim(), detailHref: href, taskId: taskIdMatch ? taskIdMatch[1] : '' }; })()
steps.description: 读取首个审核任务信息

steps.expression: (() => { const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')); const detailLink = links.find(a => a.href.includes('task/detail') || a.textContent.includes('审核详情')); return { detailHref: detailLink?.href, hasDetail: !!detailLink }; })()

(() => { const imgs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img[src*="imgextra"], img[src*="oss"], video')); const first = imgs[0]; return { src: first?.src || first?.getAttribute('src'), tag: first?.tagName }; })()

(() => { const toolbar = document.querySelector('[class*="toolbar"], [class*="action-bar"], [class*="bottom-bar"]'); if (toolbar) return { hasToolbar: true, toolbarText: toolbar.innerText }; const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b => /编辑|下载|替换|裁剪|局部修改|高清化|负反馈|复位|复制|剪辑/.test(b.innerText)); return { hasToolbar: btns.length > 0, buttonCount: btns.length, buttons: btns.map(b => b.innerText.trim()) }; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const passBtn = btns.find(b => b.innerText.includes('通过')); const rejectBtn = btns.find(b => b.innerText.includes('驳回') || b.innerText.includes('不通过')); return { hasPass: !!passBtn, hasReject: !!rejectBtn, passText: passBtn?.innerText?.trim(), rejectText: rejectBtn?.innerText?.trim() }; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const passBtn = btns.find(b => b.innerText.includes('通过')); if (passBtn) { passBtn.click(); return { clicked: 'pass' }; } return { clicked: null }; })()

steps.description: 返回个人任务中心校验进度/通过率

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tr[data-row-key]')); const row = rows[0]; if (!row) return null; const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td'); const progressCell = Array.from(cells).find(c => /进行|完成|待开始|\d\/\d/.test(c.innerText)); const passRateCell = Array.from(cells).find(c => /%|通过/.test(c.innerText)); return { progressText: progressCell?.innerText?.trim(), passRateText: passRateCell?.innerText?.trim() }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；个人任务中心至少有1个含数据的审核任务。
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 任务大厅4个来源tab；个人任务中心3个任务类型tab；审核详情页工具栏；通过/驳回按钮。
riskPoints: 无审核任务时无法进入详情
工具栏按钮DOM结构可能因素材类型变化
通过/驳回确认弹窗文案可能为'确认'而非'确定'
进度/通过率可能异步刷新需要额外等待
